_comment: Tract tables of the IBGE Census 1991 universe (DVD 'Agregado de setores', SRC/liv93703_dvd.zip). Read by assemble_tracts.py (source sets, columns, checks) and build_variables.py (VARIABLES catalog). sets: DVD data folders (Dados/<folder>/<prefix><UF>.xls). variables: name = V column of the T1 table, set + source_name = column (mnemonic, header row) of the DVD set, type integer or real (decimals). Generated once by a scratch script from the DVD layouts; edit this file from now on. checks: sum = parts add up to the total in every tract (run stops otherwise); equal = same values; le = a <= b (findings go to CONSISTENCY).
